mapper.select: SELECT (SELECT count(*) FROM perfume) AS perfume_count , (SELECT count(*) FROM ingredient) AS ingredient_count , (SELECT count(*) FROM ingredient WHERE family_code IS NULL) AS unassigned_ingredient_count , (SELECT count(*) FROM perfume_ingredient) AS perfume_note_count , (SELECT count(*) FROM perfume_accord) AS perfume_accord_count , (SELECT count(*) FROM ingredient_alias) AS ingredient_alias_count , (SELECT count(*) FROM accord_family_map) AS accord_family_map_count , (SELECT count(*) FROM search_keyword_translation) AS keyword_translation_count , (SELECT count(*) FROM ifra_standard) AS ifra_standard_count , (SELECT count(*) FROM scent_family) AS family_count

SELECT f.family_code , f.family_name_en , f.family_name_ko , f.hex_color_code , f.sort_order , count(i.ingredient_id) AS ingredient_count FROM scent_family f LEFT JOIN ingredient i ON i.family_code = f.family_code GROUP BY f.family_code ORDER BY f.sort_order, f.family_code

INSERT INTO ingredient (ingredient_name_en, ingredient_name_ko, family_code, default_note_type) VALUES (#{ingredientNameEn}, #{ingredientNameKo}, #{familyCode}, #{defaultNoteType}) ON CONFLICT (lower(ingredient_name_en)) DO UPDATE SET ingredient_name_ko = COALESCE(EXCLUDED.ingredient_name_ko, ingredient.ingredient_name_ko) , family_code = COALESCE(EXCLUDED.family_code, ingredient.family_code) , default_note_type = COALESCE(EXCLUDED.default_note_type, ingredient.default_note_type) , updated_at = now() RETURNING ingredient_id AS id, (xmax = 0) AS inserted

INSERT INTO ingredient (ingredient_name_en, default_note_type) VALUES (#{ingredientNameEn}, #{defaultNoteType}) ON CONFLICT (lower(ingredient_name_en)) DO UPDATE SET default_note_type = COALESCE(ingredient.default_note_type, EXCLUDED.default_note_type) RETURNING ingredient_id AS id, (xmax = 0) AS inserted

INSERT INTO perfume (brand_name, perfume_name, concentration, release_year) VALUES (#{brandName}, #{perfumeName}, #{concentration}, #{releaseYear}) ON CONFLICT (lower(brand_name), lower(perfume_name)) DO UPDATE SET concentration = COALESCE(EXCLUDED.concentration, perfume.concentration) , release_year = COALESCE(EXCLUDED.release_year, perfume.release_year) , updated_at = now() RETURNING perfume_id AS id, (xmax = 0) AS inserted
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO perfume_ingredient (perfume_id, ingredient_id, note_type, sort_order) VALUES (#{perfumeId}, #{ingredientId}, #{noteType}, #{sortOrder}) ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING
INSERT INTO perfume_accord (perfume_id, accord_name, strength) VALUES (#{perfumeId}, #{accordName}, #{strength}) ON CONFLICT (perfume_id, accord_name) DO UPDATE SET strength = EXCLUDED.strength
mapper.select: INSERT INTO ingredient_alias (alias_name, ingredient_id) SELECT #{aliasName}, i.ingredient_id FROM ingredient i WHERE lower(i.ingredient_name_en) = lower(#{ingredientNameEn}) ON CONFLICT (lower(alias_name)) DO UPDATE SET ingredient_id = EXCLUDED.ingredient_id RETURNING ingredient_alias_id AS id, (xmax = 0) AS inserted

INSERT INTO accord_family_map (accord_name, family_code) VALUES (#{accordName}, #{familyCode}) ON CONFLICT (accord_name) DO UPDATE SET family_code = EXCLUDED.family_code , updated_at = now() RETURNING accord_family_map_id AS id, (xmax = 0) AS inserted

INSERT INTO search_keyword_translation (keyword_ko, keyword_en, source_type) VALUES (#{keywordKo}, #{keywordEn}, 'ADMIN') ON CONFLICT (keyword_ko) DO UPDATE SET keyword_en = EXCLUDED.keyword_en , source_type = 'ADMIN' , updated_at = now() RETURNING search_keyword_translation_id AS id, (xmax = 0) AS inserted
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO admin_import_log (import_type, file_name, total_count, inserted_count, updated_count, failed_count, message) VALUES (#{importType}, #{fileName}, #{totalCount}, #{insertedCount}, #{updatedCount}, #{failedCount}, #{message})
mapper.select: SELECT log_id , import_type , file_name , total_count , inserted_count , updated_count , failed_count , message , to_char(created_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Seoul', 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS created_at FROM admin_import_log ORDER BY log_id DESC LIMIT #{limit}
